question:
Which of the following is a humorous edit of this artist or movie name: 'i spit on your grave'?
Options:
(A) i spit on your erave
(B) i spit on your brave
(C) i skit on your grave
(D) i spit on your gravy

segments.text: We need to determine which option is a humorous edit of the artist or movie name "i spit on your grave".
Likely a humorous edit changes a word to something funny.
A: "i spit on your erave" - just typo, not humorous.
B: "i spit on your brave" - changes grave to brave, maybe humorous?
C: "i skit on your grave" - changes spit to skit, comedic?
D: "i ... gravy" - changes grave to gravy, that's funny.
Probably "i spit on your gravy" (D) because gravy is a food, comedic.
Also "i skit on your grave" is a pun.
The phrase "i spit on your grave" is a song/artist?
The humorous edit likely changes a single letter to make a funny phrase. "gravy" is one letter change (e->v).
That seems like a typical meme edit.
